items.label: SUPER STURDY
items.value: The medium density fiberboard used in this ottoman is made from FSC certified wood, strong and durable, has the load bearing capacity up to 600 lbs (static load capacity). The thick padding and soft fabric make this end of bed bench comfortable and welcoming in any entryway or bedroom

items.label: COMFORTABLE SEAT
items.value: 43.3"L x 15"W x 15"H (110 x 38 x 38 cm), suitable height for sitting & resting your feet or legs. Inner filled with highly elastic sponge pad, more comfortable for sitting.

items.label: Good-looking appearance
items.value: Teddy fabric feels comfortable and soft. The simple lines give this oval faux teddy stool an understated modern feel. This Ottoman is soft, comfortable and lovely, adding to the comfort of home life.

items.label: FOLDABLE & EASY TO ASSEMBLE
items.value: it's easy to assemble,set up only takes seconds. Unfolding, position base piece and cover. It’s lightweight folding design allows you to store this ottoman away when not in use.

items.label: LARGE STORAGE SPACE
items.value: 120L capacity, perfect for taming clutter in your bedroom, living room, hallway, or utility room. The two included removable dividers let you neatly separate and organize books, clothes, blankets, shoes, and other items into dedicated sections for instant access.
